title: Looking for alpha users for PredixLab
author: wangqiao11
selftext: I'm one of the developers behind PredixLab, a US stock research tool for individual investors who like to make their own calls with data. unlike main other screener tools, we only focus on nasdaq-100 and S&P 500, and at the same, we provide pre-filtered signals, and it's easy to integrate with your own personal agent like grok bot, chatgpt, codex, etc.

comments.author: wangqiao11
comments.body:
What we're offering alpha users:

\- visit [https://predixlab.com](https://predixlab.com/) for registration.

\- After you sign up, email [contact@predixlab.com](mailto:contact@predixlab.com) from your account's email address and we'll add one more month of Premium. No payment method needed.
